source: Owner (JD) 14 Nov 2026: generic icons (clapping hands, spanner and hammer) are off-brand and distracting; HB and APEX should have flagged it.
principles: HB is a hummingbird. Its world is the garden: hummingbirds, flowers, nectar, the sundial (the day). Use these motifs, not generic office symbols.

Icons are HB line icons: SVG on a 16 grid, stroke 1.3, round caps and joins, currentColor - like core/icons.js. Never a coloured emoji in the finished interface; HB messages may start with a marker emoji that the page swaps for the HB icon (frontend/static/js/views/hb-brand-icons.js).
Colour follows the theme: icons and highlights use var(--accent), so a yellow theme makes every icon yellow. No hard-coded colours in icons.
Animation is small and alive: a wing flutter, a gentle hover, a breathing sleep - never flashy, and off for people who prefer reduced motion.
Words are plain, warm and short. Credit is a flower given to whoever did the work; a correction is the better way, never blame.

icons.credit / thank-you: a flower (marker 🌺) given to the one who did the work
icons.asking Fred / Fred taking over: a hummingbird flying to a flower (markers 🤔 and 🛠)
icons.the day: the sundial shows the real day name

check: Before anything visible ships: does it use HB motifs, the theme colour and HB line icons? If not, say so and propose the HB version.
